cohort: Placenta accreta spectrum disorder (PAS) patients who underwent cesarean delivery at a tertiary hospital from January 2015 to March 2022
finding: While PBO did not significantly reduce blood loss, hysterectomy rates, or postoperative hospital stay in PAS patients, it was associated with a decreased risk of massive hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Prophylactic balloon occlusion in patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorder undergoing cesarean delivery did not reduce the blood loss, hysterectomy rate, or postoperative hospital stay, but it prolonged the operation time and increased the cost of hospitalization.
